note: The collection channel each document came through. The metadata profiles already varied by file type; this names the source that produced them, so the difference is something you can group by.

Exchange Online.profile: email metadata populated, no EXIF, no Drive fields

OneDrive.collects: Personal cloud drive: loose Office documents and PDFs
OneDrive.profile: Office properties populated, no email metadata

Network Share.collects: File server: loose documents, archives and unsupported formats
Network Share.profile: Office properties populated, no email metadata, ZIP containers. Shares a profile with OneDrive on purpose: two sources whose metadata looks the same is a real case, and a widget still has to group them separately

Mobile Extraction (UFDR).collects: Cellebrite handset extraction: chat, photos, call logs
Mobile Extraction (UFDR).profile: EXIF including GPS, camera make and model, RSMF, structured call logs

Scanned Production.profile: OCR required, shorter and messier extracted text, no email metadata

Microsoft Teams.profile: RSMF fields, placeholders for unsupported events, no email metadata

Slack Export.profile: RSMF fields keyed on the channel, no email metadata

Exchange (PST export).collects: Archived mail handed over as container files
Exchange (PST export).profile: container parents with no natives, children carry unreliable dates
